text:
molly: Quick sync on model-catalog launch + new open models onboarding. TL;DR: we need ownership for license checks, perf profiles by EOD Thurs, infra validation for ded/hosted, and Product sign-off for rollout gating. 

Please reply with status and blockers.

Checklist:
- model list finalized (molly)
- license review (legal + dan)
- perf runs & profiles (arjun)
- infra capacity/config (ops)
- console listing + metadata (sarah/product)

Include links or PRs if ready.

---

dan: I can own license reviews. I'll queue models today. Any that are GPL-2-only or ambiguous I’ll flag. If you already have SPDX ids, paste them here.

molly: thanks — I put the current set in the internal sheet: https://redwood.internal/docs/model-catalog-draft (rows 1-12 are the new ones). SPDX IDs in col F.

arjun: perf runs scheduled on forked infra at 11:30 PT. Will run the 512/2048 seq suites + latency p95. Uploading profiles to s3: s3://redwood-perf/runs/1712001234/ (will add a summary json).

sarah: Product question — what rollout gate are we using? do we want a canary with traffic split or immediate gradual rollout? I'm leaning canary 5% for 24h then 25% then 100%.

dan: noted on GPLs. For anything non-compatible we'll propose either dual-license or remove. Will tag legal if there's ambiguity.

ops-bot: reserve-dedicated-pool created: pool-id rdw-pp-031. Capacity: 4xA100 (reserved), autoscale=off. Use region us-west-2.

molly: @sarah can you confirm canary plan? @arjun will create perf badge entries that the Console can display (token-cost, p95, mem).

arjun: yep — I'll add a small summary file that the Console consumes. Example payload: ```{"model":"open-llama-7b","p95_ms":123,"tokens_per_sec":45}```. Will PR to infra-metrics repo.

dan: FYI license checklist I'm starting:
- SPDX present? yes/no
- commercial restrictions? yes/no
- attribution req? yes/no
- approval status: pending/approved
I'll update the sheet with these cols.

sarah: can we get product metadata: example prompts and a short safety note for the Console listing. I can draft safety blurb if you give me edge cases.

molly: I'll drop a few prompt templates and failure modes in the sheet by EOD. Also tagging owners: license -> dan, perf -> arjun, infra -> ops (cc ops-bot), product metadata -> sarah.

arjun: small blocker: one model uses an operator op that isn't supported in our quantized runtime; perf run will still finish but numbers might be misleading. I flagged it in the run notes. Recommendation: mark as 'quantization-unsupported' in the catalog until we add kernel.

dan: okay mark it in sheet. If legal OK, we can still host hosted-api but mark in docs and avoid it for default dedicated profiles.

ops-bot: capacity-check: current hosted headroom for 7B-class models ~ 120 concurrent tokens/s across region. Dedicated pool rdw-pp-031 reserved; notify eng-infra if you need more.

sarah: product approves canary plan. i'll create the console feature flag and a rollout plan doc.

molly: action items: dan -> license reviews (due Thu EOD), arjun -> perf profiles + PR (due Thu EOD), ops -> validate pool + infra hooks (due Fri), sarah -> product metadata + canary flag (done). I'll ping for code reviews once PRs land.

arjun: will ping eng-releases for a small deploy window after perf PR merges.

dan: started legal review for 3rd-party models; will ping if anything needs escalation. :thumbsup:

molly: great — thanks everyone. If anything blocks, drop a short note here and I'll escalate.
